tasks.title: Lecture #53
tasks.instruction: Listen to talk in a physics class.
tasks.transcript:
M: We've been talking about the law of inertia. An object moving in a straight line will continue to move in a straight line unless it is acted upon by another force. So what does this mean in the real world?
Let's look at something many people do all the time, riding a bicycle. Think about riding along in a straight line. Once the bike is moving, inertia will keep it going in a straight line. But we don't just ride in straight lines, do we? We turn at corners and steer around things that are in our way. So how do you get the bicycle not to go straight?
Easy, right? Don't you just need to turn the front wheel in the direction you want to turn? In fact, if you only turn the front wheel, you're likely to end up on the pavement. The wheel will turn, but because of inertia, your body and the rest of the bike will want to keep moving straight ahead.
So how does a cyclist avoid this? The key is to lean in.
Weight needs to shift in the direction of the turn so that the force of gravity can work against the force of inertia. Professional cyclists who move at high speeds need to hit a sweet spot, lean more to keep their bicycles from sliding out of turns, but not too much. At a certain point, gravity will bring both rider and bicycle down to the ground.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the talk?

options.A: To show how easy it is to conduct a physics experiment
options.B: To describe the discovery of a law of physics
options.C: To explain two physical forces acting on a moving bicycle
options.D: To offer reasons why many physicists like bicycle riding

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这段讲话的目的是什么？ 定位原文：整个讲话，以"We've been talking about the law of inertia..."开始，并以自行车转弯为例解释惯性力和重力的相互作用，如"So how do you get the bicycle not to go straight? ... The key is to lean in. Weight needs to shift in the direction of the turn so that the force of gravity can work against the force of inertia." 选项分析： A. To show how easy it is to conduct a physics experiment (展示进行物理实验多么容易)。因为讲话没有讨论物理实验的难易程度，所以A选项错误。 B. To describe the discovery of a law of physics (描述一个物理定律的发现)。因为讲话是解释惯性定律的应用，而不是描述其发现过程，所以B选项错误。 C. To explain two physical forces acting on a moving bicycle (解释作用在运动自行车上的两种物理力)。因为讲话明确提到了惯性力(force of inertia)和重力(force of gravity)在自行车转弯时的作用，所以C选项正确。 D. To offer reasons why many physicists like bicycle riding (提供许多物理学家喜欢骑自行车的原因)。因为讲话没有提及物理学家或他们喜欢骑自行车的原因，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest about turning?

options.A: It is more complicated than it seems.
options.B: It is the hardest skill to learn.
options.C: It is easier to turn right than left.
options.D: It is important to go slowly.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：关于转弯，讲话者暗示了什么？ 定位原文："So how do you get the bicycle not to go straight? Easy, right? ... In fact, if you only turn the front wheel, you're likely to end up on the pavement. ... The key is to lean in." 选项分析： A. It is more complicated than it seems. (它比看起来更复杂)。因为讲话者指出转弯需要倾斜身体来对抗惯性，而不仅仅是转动车轮，暗示其复杂性，所以A选项正确。 B. It is the hardest skill to learn. (它是最难学的技能)。因为讲话没有提及转弯是最难学的技能，所以B选项错误。 C. It is easier to turn right than left. (向右转比向左转容易)。因为讲话没有比较左右转弯的难易程度，所以C选项错误。 D. It is important to go slowly. (慢行很重要)。因为讲话没有强调速度对转弯的重要性，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does leaning in help a cyclist to do?

options.D: Prevent uneven wear on the wheels

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：身体倾斜帮助骑自行车者做什么？ 定位原文："Weight needs to shift in the direction of the turn so that the force of gravity can work against the force of inertia." 选项分析： A. Go faster (骑得更快)。因为讲话没有提到倾斜身体能提高速度，所以A选项错误。 B. Avoid falling down (避免摔倒)。因为倾斜身体转移重量，让重力对抗惯性，从而防止因惯性保持直线运动而摔倒，所以B选项正确。 C. See more clearly around corners (在拐角处看得更清楚)。因为讲话没有提及视野改善，所以C选项错误。 D. Prevent uneven wear on the wheels (防止车轮磨损不均)。因为讲话没有讨论车轮磨损问题，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What do professional cyclists try to do when turning?

options.A: Slide out significantly on some turns in the road
options.B: Keep their bikes relatively upright at high speeds
options.C: Shift their weight just enough to work against inertia
options.D: Change the direction of only their front wheel

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：职业自行车手在转弯时试图做什么？ 定位原文："Professional cyclists who move at high speeds need to hit a sweet spot, lean more to keep their bicycles from sliding out of turns, but not too much." 选项分析： A. Slide out significantly on some turns in the road (在道路的一些弯道上显著地侧滑出去)。因为讲话说职业骑手需防止自行车滑出转弯(keep their bicycles from sliding out of turns)，而不是试图侧滑，所以A选项错误。 B. Keep their bikes relatively upright at high speeds (在高速时保持自行车相对直立)。因为讲话强调需要倾斜(lean more)，而不是保持直立，所以B选项错误。 C. Shift their weight just enough to work against inertia (恰好转移足够的重量以对抗惯性)。因为讲话提到“hit a sweet spot”和“lean more... but not too much”，即精确控制倾斜角度以对抗惯性，所以C选项正确。 D. Change the direction of only their front wheel (只改变前轮的方向)。因为讲话指出仅转动前轮易导致摔倒，职业骑手不采用此法，所以D选项错误。
